content.short: Footprint Analytics uncovers and visualizes blockchain data (NFT and GameFi).
content.description: Footprint Analytics is a data platform for discovering and visualizing blockchain data, including NFT and GameFi information. It collects, parses, and cleans data from 22 chains and lets users build charts and dashboards without coding via a drag-and-drop interface, or by writing SQL or Python queries. The platform provides a unified view of on-chain data for analysts and developers, enabling insightful exploration of trends, markets, and cross-chain activity.
